summary: Iter107 — Popup Sweep verification: window.confirm/window.prompt calls replaced with the shared ConfirmDialog component on Appointments, Staff and Inventory pages. All target dialogs open with correct titles/messages, Cancel closes cleanly with no side effects, Confirm actually performs the action (verified end-to-end on Inventory delete + Staff Disable/Enable toggle). Owner PIN unlock (4321) required for Staff page — confirmed in test flow. POS full regression was NOT re-run this round (iteration_106 already validated POS chargingRef fix + DuplicateBillModal; this change only touched Appointments/Staff/Inventory).

test_coverage_details.Appointments — Cancel/Delete (X) opens C: PASS — data-testid=confirm-dialog appears, title 'Cancel appointment?' matches spec
test_coverage_details.Appointments — Cancel button closes dial: PASS — dialog gone after clicking confirm-dialog-cancel; appointment row still present
test_coverage_details.Staff — Reset password dialog: PASS — title 'Reset Priya Sharma’s password?' with expected message, Cancel closes cleanly
test_coverage_details.Staff — Create login dialog (input field: PASS — title 'Create login for Anjali Mehta', confirm-dialog-input rendered, accepts text (typed 'typing.test@example.com'), Cancel closes cleanly with no login created
test_coverage_details.Staff — Disable toggle on Portal Test St: PASS — dialog 'Disable Portal Test Staff?' opens, Confirm actually toggles, toast 'Staff disabled' shown
test_coverage_details.Staff — Enable toggle on Portal Test Sta: PASS — dialog 'Enable Portal Test Staff?' opens, Confirm toggles back, toast 'Staff enabled' shown
test_coverage_details.Staff — Delete dialog opens (Cancel only: PASS — title 'Delete staff member?' opens on delete-staff-<id>, Cancel closes cleanly; PIN-protected DELETE not exercised on real staff per spec
test_coverage_details.Inventory — Delete product dialog (creat: PASS — created 'TEST Popup Sweep Product' via Add Product, delete-product-<id> opens dialog 'Delete product?', Cancel keeps product, Confirm deletes it (toast 'Deleted', row removed). Full round-trip verified.
test_coverage_details.Staff page — Owner PIN gate: PASS — /staff renders 'Staff is protected' card; PIN 4321 + Unlock button loads staff cards (9 cards visible)

critical_code_review_comments: ConfirmDialog is portalled to document.body with z-[90] and click-outside on the backdrop closes the dialog — good UX, and correctly stopPropagation on the inner card. No blocking overlay issues observed.

Staff.jsx passes inputLabel only when confirmAsk.input is truthy — meaning defaultValue prefill (s.email) is only visible when the ConfirmDialog is re-mounted per open. `key={confirmAsk.title}` ensures useState(defaultValue) re-initializes correctly for each new open — good pattern to avoid stale input state.

PIN-locked staff delete still relies on X-Owner-Pin header via pinApi.delete — not exercised in this round because Cancel path was used per spec; recommend an isolated integration test in a future round using a TEST_ staff row created purely for delete verification.

Appointments/Staff/Inventory each reimplement the same `confirmAsk` state + inline <ConfirmDialog> block (roughly 4 lines each). Consider extracting a `useConfirm()` hook returning `{ ask, dialog }` to DRY these three pages (and any future ones).

seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST inventory product ('TEST Popup Sweep Product') and DELETED it end-to-end via the dialog under test — no residual data. Portal Test Staff toggled Disable→Enable (returned to original enabled state). No appointments, invoices, or staff logins were persisted.

Staff page requires Owner PIN unlock (input the PIN then click 'Unlock with Owner PIN' button — no data-testid on either yet). TEST staff members available: 'TEST MarkLeft' (no login), 'Portal Test Staff' (login), 'TEST Staff'. For appointment delete confirm-path verification, create a disposable appointment first (add-appointment-btn).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Popup Sweep implementation is correct: (1) confirm-dialog, confirm-dialog-confirm, confirm-dialog-cancel, confirm-dialog-input testids are all present, (2) titles match spec on every page, (3) Cancel is truly a no-op (no side-effects on appointment/staff/product), (4) Confirm performs the underlying action (verified on Inventory delete + Staff toggle-active). PWA-blocking window.confirm/prompt is fully removed on the 3 target pages.
